exposure: FOXC2 mRNA expression in visceral adipose tissue
GLUT4 mRNA expression in visceral adipose tissue
cohort: The study included 60 pregnant women with gestational normal glucose tolerance (GNGT) and 21 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), with a subset of 11 GDM and 30 GNGT women providing visceral adipose tissue.
finding: Decreased adiponectin, FOXC2, and GLUT4 expression were associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes mellitus.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, when GDM diagnosis is made and samples are collected.
